notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/voxtral-small-25-07; og:url also lists /models/voxtral-small-25-07). It is a product/model catalog page (release date, context, license, params, modalities tooltips, features, pricing), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Readable text was rebuilt from HTML/RSC flight data because the page is client-rendered. Weights show Parameters/Active 24B and context 32k. Modalities Audio input / Text input / Text output come from the modality icons' accessible labels in the RSC payload. The page links Blog (mistral.ai/news/voxtral) and Technical Report (arxiv.org/pdf/2507.13264) were not used as sources; seed-lookup listed only this document. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
